name: mcp-free-cachyos
description: ChatGPT-native computer control with a persistent three-lane development coordinator for a private CachyOS MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Let ChatGPT orchestrate persistent local workers on CachyOS
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT remains the sole reasoning model while a resident private MCP coordinator queues up to three local inspection workers, persists command-level progress, exposes status/wait/result tools, applies bounded patches, verifies exact worktree bytes, and produces tamper-evident receipts.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my CachyOS computer and report its current state without changing anything.
Act as the only development model. Dispatch three persistent local lanes, observe them with status or wait, and process each completed result while the others continue.
Complete this development task through the persistent orchestration flow, preserve existing work, verify the outcome, and include every execution receipt.
